scientific_integrity: Self-contained mathematical proof and finite exact checks; no independent audit.
scientific_limitations: Unit edge weights, perfect root-degree-two binary trees and independently actuated leaves only.
Finite-field verification at heights 1 through 6 supplements, but does not establish, the all-height proof.
Near Cayley-tree leader-selection literature leaves a specialist priority risk.
title: Sharp terminal-leaf controllability of perfect binary trees with four-level resonances
